CustomField.description: HIGH-confidence threshold for the top-level extraction 'confidence' score (0-1). Replaces LLMExtractionParser.CONFIDENCE_HIGH_MIN (0.85). 🔴 NOT ONLY A DISPLAY BAND: ExtractAddressQueueable's suppression HARD GATE uses this exact value — an email is silently gated (no Lead, no registry claim) when is_acquisition_related = false AND confidence >= this threshold. Raising it gates FEWER emails (some marginal non-deals slip through as Leads); lowering it gates MORE emails (some genuine deals may be silently suppressed — no exception, no log). Change this with the care of a code deploy, not a routine Setup tweak.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 0-1. Also drives ExtractAddressQueueable's silent-suppression gate, not only display banding. See field description before changing.
CustomField.label: Confidence High Min
